metadata.notice: All identities, addresses, events, and measurements in this file are synthetic.

alerts.title: Authentication burst
alerts.detail: 27 failures from a new synthetic source within 10 minutes.

alerts.title: Off-hours privileged action
alerts.detail: A simulated root-level service change occurred outside the configured window.

alerts.title: PostgreSQL authentication threshold
alerts.detail: The one-hour failed-login threshold was exceeded in the demo dataset.

alerts.title: Security configuration changed
alerts.detail: A synthetic audit event reported a protected configuration update.

alerts.title: New remote source
alerts.detail: A documentation-range source address has not appeared in the prior demo window.
